title: Baobab Platform Relationship and Platform Account Contracts (ADR-BCP-018)
description:
Target path: baobab-platform/shared/contracts/organisation/v1/platform.schema.json

PlatformRelationship answers: how does this Organisation relate to the Baobab Platform?
PlatformAccount is a commercial / administrative grouping of organisations and tenants
that share billing, contract or operational arrangements with Baobab.

CRITICAL DISTINCTIONS:
  PlatformRelationship != ProductSubscription
  PlatformRelationship != CorporateRelationship
  PlatformAccount != Tenant
  PlatformAccount != authorization boundary
  same PlatformAccount != shared authorization
  PLATFORM_GROUP_AFFILIATE != runtime permission

Values such as PLATFORM_OWNER, PLATFORM_OPERATOR, PLATFORM_GROUP_AFFILIATE and
INTERNAL subscription eligibility are server-authoritative. External applicants
MUST NOT be able to self-assign them (ADR-BCP-017 / ADR-BCP-018).

Control Plane is the runtime authority.

platformRelationshipType.description: How the Organisation relates to Baobab Platform. Server-authoritative for privileged types.

PlatformRelationship.description: Lifecycle-managed relationship between an Organisation and the Baobab Platform. Used (together with CorporateRelationship) to derive INTERNAL subscription eligibility.

source_authority.description: Must be a server-side authority for privileged types (PLATFORM_OWNER, PLATFORM_OPERATOR, PLATFORM_GROUP_AFFILIATE).

PlatformAccount.description: Commercial or administrative account that may cover multiple Organisations and Tenants. Does not confer data access or authorization.

primary_organisation_id.description: Optional primary Organisation for the account (e.g. contracting party).

billing_reference.description: Opaque reference to commercial/billing system. No credentials.

PlatformAccountMembership.description: Links an Organisation or Tenant to a PlatformAccount for commercial/administrative purposes only.

member_id.description: Organisation canonical_entity_id or tenant_id according to member_type.

role.description: Optional commercial role within the account (e.g. BILLING_OWNER, CONSUMER). Not an IAM role.
